title: Can You Add a Guest After Booking a Private Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: Yes, if the group stays at five or fewer. The price is per boat, so a fourth or fifth guest costs nothing extra: just tell us on WhatsApp before the day.
heroAlt: A fifth guest stepping from the wooden pontoon onto the boat at Marina do Funchal
